title: Start a shift handoff
caption: Ana needs to pass along a location. When she leaves the title empty, the web app tells her which field to fix.

title: Leave a handoff
caption: Ana leaves a handoff for the next shift. The web app saves her note and returns a reference.

title: Find it again
caption: After a reload, Ana enters the reference and gets back the original handoff.

title: Keep the handoff private
caption: Bob tries the same reference. The service hides the note and tells him it was not found.

title: Work from a shell
caption: The command-line client creates a second note. Ana reads it back. Bob gets the same refusal.

title: Pick it up in the browser
caption: Ana opens the reference printed by the command-line client. The browser shows the same title and body.

title: Read in a terminal
caption: The interactive terminal opens that second note for Ana. Switching to Bob keeps its contents private.
